edits.replace: if (this.extraInterfaces != null) { java.util.List<Class<?>> all = new java.util.ArrayList<Class<?>>(java.util.Arrays.asList(this.extraInterfaces)); all.addAll(java.util.Arrays.asList(extraInterfaces)); this.extraInterfaces = all.toArray(new Class<?>[all.size()]); } else { this.extraInterfaces = extraInterfaces; }

submission_results.hypothesis: Observation: the failing mock is not Serializable when built as withSettings().serializable().extraInterfaces(List.class). Cause: MockSettingsImpl.extraInterfaces overwrites the stored interface array (this.extraInterfaces = extraInterfaces), so the later extraInterfaces(List.class) call in the chain discards the Serializable marker added by serializable(), and isSerializable() (which checks the array for Serializable) returns false. Fix: append new interfaces to any already-stored ones instead of replacing them. Parent is the original tree. Refutation: if MocksSerializationTest still throws NotSerializableException after this change, the overwrite is not the cause and the serializable check or the CGLIB proxy creation is at fault.
